title: Kangan
desc: Sunil lives a middle-classed lifestyle in a village in India along with his widowed mom, Janki. He is studying Medicine in the city, is in love with his childhood sweetheart, Shanta, and everyone expects them to get married soon. However, Janki does not approve of Shanta, finds her uncouth and illiterate, and instead approves of Shobha and arranges Sunil's marriage with her.

title: Abhimanyu
desc: Panni wreaks havoc in the lives of Manu and Tulsi, forcing them to leave the village. Years later, they return to exact a not-so-sweet revenge upon Panni.

title: Bad Aur Badnaam
desc: Story begins with three villains getting a lot of money and new identities from rich man Pedro getting killed in return. Later two secret agents - James (Sanjeev Kumar) from Ringania and Ashwinikumar (Shatrughan Sinha) from Indian intelligence Bureau are shown at the top of their game. Due to some misconception, they brcome sworn enemies but meanwhile they have their jobs to do. Ashwinikumar is investigating a mysteriousplot to kill a VVIP in Delhi while James is no a Ringanian mission in india. They fight and temporarity make Peace and the rest of the movie is about their joint effort to figure out the mystery and ruin the evil plot.

title: Param Dharam
desc: Savitri believes that her illegitimate child with her deceased lover, Vijay, was stillborn and did not survive. Years later, Savitri's world changes when she learns that her firstborn is alive.
